{"consolidated_memory":"## Broken layout in notifications/email/render.py – Two separate incidents

### Occasion 1: [2026-01-19]
**Component:** notifications/email/render.py (notifications side)
**Problem:** Broken layout in email renderer
**Trigger:** Rolling restart of the fleet
**Repro:** Render the digest template with a long subject
**Root cause:** An error swallowed by a bare except clause
**Signal:** Table overflows in the plain text part
**Result:** Nightly rollup matched the source counts for 21 days running
**Fix:** Narrowed the exception handler and let the failure propagate
**PR/Branch:** PR #5143 on branch fix/broken-layout-1

### Occasion 2: [2026-05-30]
**Component:** notifications/email/render.py (notifications side)
**Problem:** Broken layout in email renderer
**Trigger:** Sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
**Repro:** Render the digest template with a long subject
**Root cause:** Floating point rounding in the money path
**Signal:** Table overflows in the plain text part
**Result:** Cold start dropped 97 percent, to 884 ms
**Fix:** Moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
**PR/Branch:** PR #5699 on branch fix/broken-layout-2

**Context:** Both incidents affected the same corner of notifications/email/render.py; domain knowledge from the first incident carried over to the second."}
